media.title: Michele Galdieri — portrait photograph
media.altText: Black-and-white photograph of the lyricist Michele Galdieri in profile, looking down.
media.publicCaption: Michele Galdieri, Italian lyricist and playwright, in 1956. Galdieri wrote the Italian words of “Ninon” (1933) and “San Francisco” (1937).
media.publicCreditLine: Photographer unidentified; Il Radiocorriere, March 1956; Wikimedia Commons, public domain.
media.rightsNote: Wikimedia Commons tags the photograph PD-Italia: under Italian law a simple photograph is protected for twenty years from its making, so a photograph published in 1956 is in the public domain. The photographer is not identified.
